'''Chandrilan squall tendermeat''' was a form of meat from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. A dish composed of Chandrilan squall tendermeat with fresh [[colla sauce]] was served in [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]] across the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]].<ref name="Strongholds" /> It consisted of two lots of [[Squall (species)|squall]] meat served in a very rich [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]], sometimes served in upper class establishments.<ref name="Wizard">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030306squall|series=Creature Feature|text=Domesticated Squall}}</ref>
